Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Pringle
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 10/28/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 2 as introduced provides for the reapportionment and redistricting of the state into districts for the purpose of electing members of the Alabama House of Representatives. This bill will not directly affect state funding.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund

Date: 11/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 2 as passed the House of Representatives provides for the reapportionment and redistricting of the state into districts for the purpose of electing members of the Alabama House of Representatives. This bill will not directly affect state funding.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund
